old_row.relationship: Unresolved visitor and revelatory identity; not retained
old_row.rationale: Eliphaz reports an unrecognized form with a breeze and voice. The Elijah narrative explicitly identifies the Lord in the gentle-breeze encounter. Similar sensory words do not establish the identity or authority of Eliphaz’s reported visitor.

new_row.relationship: Unresolved visitor and revelatory identity; not retained
new_row.rationale: Eliphaz reports that he did not recognize it and saw no form, but heard a breeze and voice. The Elijah narrative explicitly identifies the Lord in the gentle-breeze encounter. Similar sensory words do not establish the identity or authority of Eliphaz’s reported visitor.

changes.reason: The supplied report says no form was seen; do not recast this as an unrecognized form.
